whole.description: The bar, sheet or disc to cut.

cuts.description: Cut lines in board coordinates, offered as dashed score lines.

material.description: Sets edge texture and contact sound.

slice.description: A whole parts along cut lines into pieces that keep their size, so equal parts can be seen to make the whole.
useWhen: fractions of a bar, strip, sheet or disc
showing a whole is unchanged by cutting
notFor: shading parts without separating them (use shade)
sharing a set of discrete objects (use share)

gesture.demo: Max may cut once on a non-target case.

phases: Offer: dashed score lines, --cc-base 2.5
Cut: the tool travels the line; a tapered slash trail follows and closes behind it
Part: after every cut, the pieces either side open by `gap` along the cut
slice.sound: Knife: rising air swoosh, blade hiss and a short metallic ring. Scissors: one snip per blade close. Wheel: rolling rumble with crust crunch. Each material adds its contact sound: crisp paper, soft pizza, chocolate snap.
slice.endState: Pieces rest parted by `gap`, each its original size and place.
slice.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

material.description: Card is heavier: lower landing sound.

fold.description: A flap turns 180° about an axis onto the rest of the sheet, showing halves, symmetry or equivalence by coincidence.
notFor: reflection of a shape across a mirror line on a plane (use transform.reflect)

input: tap the sheet or the dashed axis
drag the flap across the axis (past halfway completes, before falls back)

phases: Crease: dashed axis
Turn: the flap rotates 180° toward the viewer; its reverse side shows past 90°
Land: the crease stays as a line, folded or open
timing: Released drag finishes in proportion to the angle left, ease-out
Depth cue: black layer up to 12% on the flap, 10% under it
fold.sound: Air swoosh while turning. Landing: a crisp crease tick for paper, a low thud for card.
fold.endState: Flap rests on the other half; crease stays as a line after unfolding.
fold.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

jump.description: A token moves along a number line as unit hops or one leap; each trail stays, labelled at its apex, so the size of the move can be read.
useWhen: addition and subtraction on a number line

input: tap a number to leap there

phases: Take-off
Arc: token and trail share one eased progress, so it stays on its line
Land: step label fades in at the apex
jump.sound: Take-off glide and a landing tap, the same pitch on every hop.
jump.endState: Token rests on `to`; every trail stays with its label until the stage changes.
jump.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

children.description: Up to 4 children; a child may hold its own children (2 levels).

branch.description: A choice opens into up to four options along drawn connectors; the chosen path stays lit.

input: tap a button (it carries a chevron) to open or close
gesture.notes: Only buttons open; flat surfaces never do.

phases: Open: chevron turns 90°, connectors draw, children travel out of the parent
Second level opens from its button the same way; that button takes selected and its path lights
Close: reverse order, deepest level first, back into the parent
branch.sound: Open: rising air plus a tick per child arriving. Close: falling air.
branch.endState: Chosen path lit; siblings muted, never hidden while the question is open.
branch.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

reorder.description: Cards are put in order by the learner; others make room; the order is judged where the learner left it.
useWhen: ordering numbers, fractions, steps of a method
notFor: sorting rows of a data table (use table.sort)

input: arrow keys on a focused card

phases: Lift: rises 8px, tilts up to 2.5° about the grab point, deep shadow, a sheen crosses it
Carry: follows 1:1; swings with speed (±4°); others make room
Drop: settles, springs level with one small overshoot
Check marks in place; Reveal is the last rung
timing: Settle --cc-enter ease-out; tilt on a spring
reorder.sound: Lift glide, a tick per slot passed, a soft drop. Judgement uses the existing correct / wrong tones.
reorder.endState: Cards rest in the learner order, each marked; the reveal is the last rung.
reorder.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

flip.description: A card turns over to show the same quantity in another representation.
notFor: revealing a hidden answer under a cover (use reveal)
phases: Rise: the card comes 28px toward the viewer
Turn: 180° about its axis; the shadow thins at 90°
Settle back to the board
flip.sound: A short card whip as it turns, a light tap as it lands.
flip.endState: Card rests on its other face, flat on the board.
flip.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

rotate.description: A shape turns about a point; the start stays as a ghost and a vertex draws its arc with the angle.
phases: Pivot shown
Turn: the shape rotates; A's arc draws with it, arrowhead leading
Rest: the angle label sits at the arc's middle; ghost of the start stays
rotate.sound: A ratchet tick every 15°, a soft stop at the end.
rotate.endState: Shape rests turned; ghost of the start and the labelled arc stay.
rotate.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

reveal.description: A cover lifts off to show what is underneath; the content rises into place.
useWhen: revealing an answer after the learner commits
phases: Lift: the cover slides out of the card (slide) or parts in two (doors)
Rise: content moves up 14px and fades in
Sheen: one pass across
reveal.sound: A slide of air and one short rising shimmer.
reveal.endState: Content shown; cover gone (cover() restores it).
reveal.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

stack.description: Loose items travel one by one into a stack while the count builds where it can be seen.
notFor: regrouping ten ones into a ten (use regroup)
phases: Lift and arc to the slot (apex 60 above the higher end)
Land with a 3px settle
Count updates beside the stack; unstack runs top first
stack.sound: A wood-block tock per cube, a paper slap per card, same pitch each time.
stack.endState: Items rest stacked; count shown beside the stack.
stack.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

roll.description: A rolled sheet opens as the roll travels across it, and closes back the same way.
useWhen: unrolling a length or a scroll of content

input: tap the roll or the sheet (clickable only while open)

phases: Roll travels; the sheet appears behind it
The roll's surface turns as it moves
Close reverses it
roll.sound: Paper rustle with a flutter for the whole travel, a soft tap at the end.
roll.endState: Sheet open (or closed); the roll rests at the far end.
roll.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

principles.description: Switchable: slowInOut, arc, anticipation, followThrough, secondary. squashStretch is OFF (breaks P01).

timing.description: By distance (--cc-morph under 300px, --cc-draw beyond) or fixed ms.

move.description: An object changes position with the principles of motion (slow in/out, arc, anticipation, follow-through); a refused drop returns home.
useWhen: translating any object across the board
returning an object refused by a no-go zone
phases: Anticipation: 14px back-step, 160ms
Travel: ease-in-out along an arc bowing 28% of the distance
Follow-through: 7% overshoot, settles
No-go: border goes solid wrong while over; on arrival wrong hue and cross, shake, 260ms pause, back to start; the mark clears as it leaves
timing: Show spacing draws a ghost every 45ms: close ghosts are slow, far apart are fast
move.sound: Air whoosh that follows the speed; a soft landing tap. Refused: a low thunk, then a falling whoosh on the way back.
move.endState: Object at `to`; or, if refused, back at its start with the mark cleared.
move.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

mode.description: Tap one part, or drag-paint across parts (a drag starting on a shaded part clears).

shade.description: Parts inside a whole take shading in the direction they belong (sector from the centre, square from its base, liquid to a level); the count names the result.
phases: Tap or drag over a part
Fill travels into the part along its own direction: centre outward (sector), bottom up (square), rising level (container)
The count beside the whole names the result; tapping a shaded part clears it the same way back
timing: Demo shades one part per --cc-beat, like count()
shade.sound: Sector: a soft brush. Square: a small tick, same pitch each time. Bottle: a pour that rises while filling and falls while draining.
shade.endState: Shaded parts at --cc-fill2; count beside the whole.
shade.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

dragTo.description: An item is placed on a target; near a slot it lights and snaps; right stays marked, wrong shakes and returns home, off-target returns unmarked.
useWhen: placing numbers on a number line
phases: Lift: edge plus raised shadow; follows 1:1
Hover a target within 48px: slot lights (one at a time), tick
Drop: snap to the slot; judge; wrong returns home, off-target returns without a mark
timing: Wrong: shake --cc-morph, 260ms hold, return --cc-morph; mark clears 40% of the way
dragTo.sound: Lift glide, a tick per target lit, a click on snap, then the correct or wrong tones. Returns get a falling whoosh.
dragTo.endState: Item in its slot marked correct, or back home.
dragTo.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

balance.source: §13 Interaction · preset 14 · Balance and equation moves

op.description: Operation applied: op in +,−,×,÷; sides both|left|right.

balance.description: A balance scale and its equation change together: the same operation on both sides keeps the beam level; one side only tips it and = becomes ≠.
useWhen: doing the same to both sides
notFor: symbolic solving without a model (use steps)
phases: Items leave a pan: rise 24px and fade, one --cc-stagger apart
Beam settles on a spring to its new angle (±14° max)
A term travels across =; its sign flips halfway; joined terms travel together, fade, and their result appears
balance.sound: A pop per item, a wooden creak when the beam moves, a whoosh as a term crosses, a tick when terms combine.
balance.endState: Beam level (both sides) or tipped with ≠ (one side); equation simplified.
balance.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

share.description: Counters are dealt one at a time into groups in turn; what cannot be shared stays behind, named.
notFor: division as grouping in tens (use regroup)
phases: Each counter arcs from the pile to the next group
Group counts update as each one lands
Remainder stays in the pile, ringed, with "n left over"
share.sound: A wood-block tock per counter, the same pitch every time.
share.endState: Equal groups with counts; remainder ringed with "n left over".
share.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

regroup.description: Ten ones line up and become one ten that travels to the tens column (or back): the digits change, the number never does.
useWhen: carrying and borrowing with base-ten blocks
phases: Gather: ten ones line up, a tick each
Join: the column becomes one rod (ones fade out as the rod fades in, same place)
Travel: the rod moves to its column; the rest close up
regroup.sound: Ticks while gathering, a zip on the join, a soft drop when it lands.
regroup.endState: Blocks in their new columns; digits updated.
regroup.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

steps.description: Ordered: point, segment, arc(centre, radius), intersect, join.

construct.description: A construction runs step by step with the real instruments: pencil segments, compass arcs, marked intersections, joins.
phases: Point fades in; the pencil draws the segment
The compass swings: needle at the centre, pencil leg tracing the arc
Intersection marked; joining segments drawn; tools leave
construct.sound: Pencil scratch for the length of each stroke; a faint metallic note as the compass starts.
construct.endState: Construction complete; tools gone; only geometry remains.
construct.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

transform.call: translate(shape, v) · reflect(shape, mirror) · dilate(shape, O, k) · fit(shape, target)
transform.description: Each transformation shows its rule first (vector, mirror line, rays from O), leaves the original as a ghost, and relabels A→A′ halfway.
phases: Show the rule first: vector, mirror line, or rays from O
Move the shape; labels turn to A′ B′ C′ halfway
Fit: turn about the centre, then travel; the target goes correct when it fits
timing: Dilation is the one scale in the system: it is the maths (needs a rule exception)
transform.sound: Whoosh on travel, a card whip on reflect, a rising glide on dilate, the correct tones on a fit.
transform.endState: Image and ghost on board; primes on image labels.
transform.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.
exceptions: Dilation scales the shape: the scale is the mathematics (P01 exception).

plot.source: §13 Interaction · preset 19 · Plot on a plane
plot.description: A point walks along x then y leaving guides; two points give a line; slope steps run then rise.
phases: Walk x one unit at a time, then y
Guides stay; the point fills and is labelled
Slope: run arrow, then rise arrow, step by step
timing: One unit 120ms (50ms for a quick plot)
plot.sound: A tick per unit step, a click when the point lands, a scratch as the line draws.
plot.endState: Points labelled with guides; line drawn; slope steps shown.
plot.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

measure.description: An instrument travels in and turns to seat (zero on the start, baseline on the base); a guide drops and the reading appears.
useWhen: reading a length with a ruler
reading an angle with a protractor
notFor: dimension lines on a drawing (use dims)
phases: Instrument travels and rotates into place
Snap: zero on the start, baseline on the base
Reading: guide or arc, then the value
measure.sound: A slide whoosh, a click when it seats, a tick at the reading.
measure.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

area.source: §13 Interaction · preset 21 · Build area and arrays
area.description: Unit squares (or dots) fill a region row by row with a running total, so area or a product is counted, not stated.
phases: Tiles arc from the stack into their cells, left to right
Each finished row shows its running total
Total named: 4 rows of 6 = 24
area.sound: A tock per tile, same pitch; the correct tone when it is complete.
area.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

zoom.source: §13 Interaction · preset 22 · Zoom into a number line
zoom.description: One interval opens to full width as it moves down, its new subdivisions spreading with it; funnel lines keep the link to where it came from.
phases: Interval highlighted
The interval opens: ends and ticks spread to full width while it moves down; funnel lines follow its ends
New labels fade in left to right; zoom out runs it backwards
zoom.sound: A whoosh into the new level and a tick per new step.
zoom.endState: New level shown below with labels; zoomOut reverses.
zoom.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

net.description: Faces with hinge edges and fold order.
Side faces turn up on shared edges and the last face closes the lid while the view tilts, so the solid can be read.
phases: Side faces turn up 90° together on their shared edges
The lid face turns last (it hangs from a side face)
The view tilts so all three dimensions show
timing: Lid starts 40% of the way through
net.sound: A whoosh across the fold and a soft tick as each face turns.
net.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

chart.description: Bars rise from the baseline while their values count up; sort moves whole bars; pie slices sweep in with their share.
phases: Bars rise one after another, values counting up
Sort: bars travel to their new order
Pie: each slice sweeps, then its label fades in
chart.sound: A short rising glide per bar; a brush per slice.
chart.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

match.description: The learner links two representations; a link draws; equal keeps and marks both, not equal shakes and pulls the link back.

input: tap one, then tap the other

phases: First tap: selected
Second tap on the other side: link draws
Judge: keep and mark, or shake and retract
timing: Show links runs each in turn
match.sound: A click on select, a whoosh as the link draws, then the correct or wrong tones.
match.endState: Correct links stay; wrong ones retracted.
match.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

tools.description: Up to 6 tools on the dial.

dial.description: Tools are not on the board until called: the board recedes, a dial of tools opens, the picked tool travels to where it is used.
useWhen: any task that needs an instrument (ruler, compass, protractor, set square, pencil, calculator)
phases: Board recedes to 78%; six slots travel out from the hub, 40ms apart
Hover lights a slot and names it in the hub
Pick: other slots fold in, the tool travels to its place
dial.sound: A rising air as it opens, a tick per slot and per hover, a click on pick, a soft drop when the tool lands.
dial.endState: Picked tool at its place of use; board restored.
dial.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

dims.source: §13 Interaction · preset 27 · Length, height and depth

offset.description: Distance of the dimension line from the object, px.

dims.description: A dimension line draws from A to B between extension lines with its value counting up at the head, then settles at the middle.
useWhen: length, height, depth of objects and solids
phases: Extension lines from both ends, 6px clear of the object
Dimension line draws A to B; running value rides the head; a tick each whole unit
Value settles at the middle, outside the object
dims.sound: A light pencil scratch for the draw, a tick per unit, a click when it reaches B.
dims.endState: Dimension with value at its middle, outside the object.
dims.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

angle.description: An arc grows from the first arm to the second with degrees counting at its tip; the value settles on the bisector; a right angle gets a square.
phases: Arc grows from arm 1 to arm 2 (reflex uses a smaller radius)
Running degrees ride the arc tip; a tick every 10°
Value settles on the bisector, outside the arc
angle.sound: A tick per 10° while measuring, per 5° while dragging; a click at the end.
angle.endState: Arc (or square) with value on the bisector outside the arc.
angle.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

points.call: point(P) · segment(A, B) · ray(A, B) · line(A, B)
points.description: Each object draws the way it is defined: a point with one ring, a segment stops at B, a ray runs past B to the edge with one arrowhead, a line grows both ways with two.
phases: Point: dot, one fading ring, label rises 6px
Segment: A, then B, then the line between
Ray and line: draw past the points to the edge, then arrowheads fade in
points.sound: A pop per point, a pencil scratch per line.
points.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

grid.description: Graph paper draws major lines in sequence then minor lines fade in; a coordinate grid grows from the origin outward one unit at a time.
useWhen: graph paper for area or drawing
phases: Graph paper: major lines draw in sequence; minor lines fade in
Coordinate grid: axes from the origin, arrowheads, then lines and numbers outward
Numbers fade with their lines
grid.sound: One soft sweep for the reveal, a tick per ring.
grid.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

compass.source: §13 Interaction · preset 31 · Compass with a ruler

r.description: Radius in cm (read off the ruler).

compass.description: The compass is opened against the ruler to a radius, carried to the centre and draws; a dotted radius joins needle and pencil only while the compass is visible.
useWhen: circles and arcs of a given radius
phases: Pick ruler, pick compass (dial)
Needle on 0; pencil leg opens to r; value shown
Carry to O; draw the arc with the dotted radius; the compass lifts away and the dotted radius goes with it
compass.sound: Clicks when the needle seats and the leg stops, a scratch with a faint ring for the arc.
compass.endState: Arc drawn; compass and dotted radius gone.
compass.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

protractor.source: §13 Interaction · preset 32 · Plot an angle with a protractor
protractor.description: The protractor seats on the vertex along the base ray; a marker runs the scale to the angle and a dot is marked; the protractor leaves and the ray is drawn through the dot.
useWhen: drawing an angle of a given size
notFor: measuring an existing angle (use angle or measure)
phases: Vertex and base ray; pick the protractor; seat it
Marker runs 0 to the angle with the count; tick lights; dot marked
Protractor away; dotted line through the dot and beyond; ray and angle arc drawn
protractor.sound: Ticks every 10° along the scale, a click on the target angle, a scratch for the ray, the correct tones at the end.
protractor.endState: Ray and labelled angle arc; protractor gone.
protractor.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

physics.description: Things with weight move by simulation, not easing: they fall and bounce lower each time, swing and slow down, speed up down a slope.
useWhen: any object that should feel heavy
notFor: abstract tokens and symbols (use tweened moves)

input: drag a swinging object and let go

phases: Fall: gravity 2600 px/s², bounce keeps 32% of speed, a small tilt that settles
Swing: pendulum on its string, damping 0.9; drag to pull
Slide: speeds up down the slope (friction 0.25), small bounce at the stop
physics.sound: A thud per impact, louder for faster ones; a low creak at each turn of the swing; a rumble that rises with speed down the slope.
physics.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

table.call: fill(table) · find(table, x) · missing(table, cells) · sort(table, col)

rule.description: Function rule in the header (function tables).

table.description: A table fills row by row; a value is found by working, not lookup: the rule leaves the header, the row value is substituted, each line comes from the one above, and the answer returns to its cell. A missing input runs the rule backwards.
phases: Fill: each row rises in, its value types in
Find: row band travels, rule flies out of the header, x is substituted, working collapses line by line, answer flies into the cell
Missing: forward for a missing y, backward (inverse operations cross the =) for a missing x; Sort: rows travel, header arrow turns
table.sound: A tick per value typed, a click on the found cell, a whoosh when rows move.
table.endState: Cells filled by working; working kept beside the table; rows in order after sort.
table.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.

mode.description: "expr" adds a hanging = to every line after the first; "eq" lines carry their own relation.

steps.description: Every line of working is made from the line before it: tokens copy down, split, merge, cross the = and cancel; in column methods every digit sits in its place-value column.
useWhen: written column methods (addition with carry, long division)
notFor: labels that name a step instead of showing it
phases: Copy down: the line slides down as the new working line; the old one dims
Focus: a box goes round the part being changed and follows it as it grows
Rewrite in place: a term splits (9 becomes 3 × 3) or merges (3 × 2 becomes 6) while neighbours travel to make room
Same thing, same colour: shared factors light together, then copies drop and merge into one
Cross the equals: a term travels to the other side and its operation flips halfway
Place value is fixed: a digit at rest is always centred on its column (ones under ones, tens under tens), including products, remainders and carries
Long division: product and remainder form where they are written; the next digit drops down along a dotted path
HCF and LCM: numbers step down the ladder, changing as they go; the left side gives the HCF, the L shape gives the LCM
Matrices: a row band and a column band cross; pairs meet as products, and the products meet in the cell

Carry: copies of the column's digits drop into the answer slot; each copy fades as it crosses the line and the sum appears just below it; an overfull sum shows at 55% size and trembles gently, its ten arcs up to the next column, and the ones digit grows to full size
timing: Overfull shake 900ms; carry --cc-morph; settle --cc-morph with a small overshoot
steps.sound: A tick per symbol typed, a whoosh when a line or term travels, a pop when something splits or merges, a drop when it lands. An overfull sum rattles while it shakes. No side labels: the movement carries the meaning, and the status chip names each step for the reader.
steps.endState: Final line boxed; history kept in faint ink.
steps.reducedMotion: Lands on the end state at once; the end sound plays once.
exceptions: Column addition: an overfull column sum shows at 55% and grows to full size after the carry leaves (P01 exception).
